stages.description: Download and cache historical election results when the corresponding pickle is absent.
stages.notes: The supported election list and source-specific overrides are maintained in election_data.py. This acquisition stage has no file-category input beyond its source revision.

stages.description: Validate cached results, simplify party names and export the CSVs consumed by C++.
stages.notes: Export is cache-only at runtime. For provenance, each election's pickle and CSV are certified together as internal outputs of the election-result code path rather than treating the pickle as an independently authored input.

stages.description: Fit historical seat, regional and Coalition-allocation models.
Run leave-one-pollster-out trend models and write a compact staging component.
stages.notes: Known likely bug: state calibration currently reads normal federal outputs. It should use matching federal calibration output, preferring the same excluded pollster and falling back to the full calibration trend.

stages.description: Generate bias-calibration evidence and promote a compact summary when leave-one-out staging is available.
stages.notes: Known likely bug: state bias calibration currently reads normal federal outputs. It should use federal _biascal output.

stages.description: Validate and compact retained legacy calibration files when a summary is absent.
stages.notes: New fp_model.py runs promote summaries directly. This stage is retained solely to compact existing detailed archives without rerunning Stan.

stages.description: Reduce calibration output into per-election pollster parameters.
stages.notes: Complete compact summaries are preferred per election; detailed compatibility files remain a legacy fallback.

stages.description: Generate voting-intention-only trends used by approval analysis.
stages.notes: State pure runs optionally use existing pure trends from every overlapping federal cycle as minor-party priors, restricted to parties significant in both elections. Federal runs do not use federal trend outputs as priors. Full regeneration should therefore run the relevant federal pure trends before dependent state trends. Only pure TPP trend and poll files are known to be consumed by approvals.py; other pure party outputs require a later consumer audit.

stages.description: Generate approval-derived observations and the normal trends, adjusted polls and house effects used by forecasts.
stages.notes: The command derives synthetic TPP observations from pure trends and passes them directly to the final models. The jurisdiction CSV is retained as a diagnostic snapshot, not as an input boundary. State normal runs should follow federal normal runs. Federal runs should not read their own existing output as a prior.

stages.description: Generate consolidated point-in-time historical trend fits at the triangular cutoff schedule used by trend adjustment.
stages.notes: The schedule contains the same 46 triangular day points used by trend_adjust.py, from 0 through 1035 days before election day. Scheduled points that contain no new polling information are skipped. Each invocation builds a replacement consolidated file in a working path and promotes it only after every endpoint is complete. Each file contains all parties, the scheduled day, the actual latest-poll endpoint, posterior percentiles and Stan seeds. Trend adjustment indexes and interpolates by the actual endpoint rather than treating a stale poll as if it occurred on the scheduled day. State cutoffs use matching federal cutoff files available by the state endpoint, not normal federal trend files. Because this stage is exceptionally slow, cutoff plans require current calibration, pollster-parameter and pure-trend dependencies rather than tolerating inherited staleness.

stages.description: Estimate fundamentals and trend-adjustment parameters from historical trends and election results.
stages.notes: Each target is recorded only after all configured party-group adjustments and its fundamentals file have been written. Fundamentals depend only on authored election/context data; adjustment records additionally depend on the consolidated cutoff work unit for every historical election used to calibrate that target. Missing interior endpoints are interpolated in triangular-root time using the actual poll endpoint, dates after the latest poll retain its value, and dates before the first poll provide no observation.

A TPP or ONP work unit is required only when its election-specific Regional/*-polls*.csv file contains at least one non-Election poll row. Missing and baseline-only files are skipped rather than treated as stale generated data.

stages.description: Run the jurisdiction-specific scraper needed to archive historical booth results for live analysis.
stages.notes: Scrapers are jurisdiction-specific and currently have different command-line behaviour.

stages.description: Download/cache federal booth results and calculate federal swing deviations for manual transfer into state forecast seat files.
stages.notes: The derived seat deviations are printed rather than written directly. They are manually copied into fTransposedFederalSwing in seats/*.txt, so changes require review and an authored forecast_seats provenance update.

consumers.description: C++ seat-level simulation preparation and execution.
Manual preparation of state forecast seat files, including fTransposedFederalSwing values derived by federal_state.py.
